notes.frame: Phosphor's smiley (0.13 % of its ink uncovered at regular before the cut) with the ring cut and the plus placed exactly as in user-circle-plus, so the two read as one family. That is also where reaction pickers put it (top right). Fill is smiley-fill bitten round the plus; duotone tints the whole disc, as user-circle-plus-duotone does.
notes.bold: The eyes are drawn as discs of radius 16 (smiley-bold's size): a radius-4 circle under a 24 stroke would leave a pinhole.
